grades.reason: A reviewer reports their child was threatened by another player in an 'Adopt Me' game, leading to police involvement. Another reviewer warns of 'bad people' on the platform and states AI age-guessing is 'not good'. A forum post notes that while filters exist for text and voice chat, users find ways around them and may move conversations to less-monitored platforms.
A reviewer reports being unable to play without adding a payment method; after adding a card with no funds, they were charged $46 despite the game advertising as free.
The cited sources raise a concern here. Read the source quotes before deciding.
